reviews.title: Nice chair
reviews.comment: Easy to assemble and looks clean in my home office. The lumbar support is actually helpful, and I like that the arms flip up so I can tuck it under my desk. It’s comfortable for a full workday, though the seat could be a bit softer. Overall, solid value for the price.
reviews.author: TING WANG

reviews.title: Great office chair highly recommended!
reviews.comment: This office chair is easy to assemble and the instructions are clear to follow.  I am very impressed with this office chair, the seat is extremely comfortable after I sat for a long time and I feel relaxed. Also, the lumbar can be adjusted and has great back support.  Great price for the quality. Highly recommend those who are looking for the office chair.
reviews.author: TAIYUAN D.

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.comment: I bought this chair for my best friend’s new home office, and it turned out to be a great choice. She assembled it right away and said the setup was quick and straightforward. After using it for a day, she said it’s very comfortable and provides good back support( she has back issue , can’t sit too long )  The mesh back makes it feel breathable, and the design looks clean and modern in her space. So far, she’s really happy with it, and for the price, it seems like a great value.
reviews.author: AOD LIN

reviews.title: Great chair at a good price
reviews.comment: It's a great chair, comfortable and reasonably priced for an ergonomic office chair. I usually don't write reviews, but I also understand how purchasing an office chair can feel overwhelming with so many choices. I needed to replace the chair I'd purchased in 2020. At the time I'd not spent a lot of money, not sure if working remotely would be temporary or permanent. It lasted about as long as one might expect. I did quite a bit of research choosing a replacement. I'm always hesitant to purchase furniture without trying it out in person. This chair is worth the price, not on the higher end of what's available but definitely not cheap. I've had it for about three weeks and so far, it's perfect for the 8-10 hours I spend in it during the week. It arrived early, a great bonus. Assembly was quick, with easy-to-follow directions and all the tools and parts needed. (including some spare screws). I agree with others who mentioned that a spare set of hands would have helped, but I had no issue doing it myself. It's a sturdy chair with good lumbar support. The adjustability of that feature can accommodate different heights. (I'm around 5'4") Changing seat height or whether the back tilts or remains stationary are all easy to accomplish. The one minor caveat is the seat is leather, so in warm weather and shorts season, it's not ideal. I solved that by purchasing a cover (because of the way the chair fits together, I purchased one that covers both the seat and back because a seat cover by itself would not work). That has worked fine and I'm not sure whether I'll keep the cover on all year. Overall, it's a great chair at a good price.
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.title: Nice desk chair that's easy to assemble.
reviews.comment: After using chairs that are in no way conducive to sitting at a desk long term, I've finally upgraded. This chair is comfortable and is so much better than what I was using. Installation was easy enough, would take about 30 minutes or so if following directions (just guessing, as I did not). I had a limited area and decided to wing it. They label the included tools and screws for easy recognition, even include a couple of extra parts for good measure. I will say, there is a part that tells you not to tighten down the seat screws all the way, keep that in mind, cause it helps align the arm rests that attack to the seat back. Even with that, I was able to still put it together relatively quickly and without issue. The chair itself is sturdy, has a slight bit of weight to it (not as bad as the box indicated when I lifted it though) and easily supports me. It has a nice height adjustment, though the lowest setting is perfect for my short legs, and allows for a bit of a leaning motion (rocking they list it as). Arms lift up, which is one of my requirements, and the black color fits the rest of my desk area. Overall, I'm pleased with my new upgrade. If it lasts me a few years then I'll be very happy.
reviews.author: Just my .02
